_note: One short, bounded task per employee for the local Ollama runner. Employees only DRAFT; nothing is sent, posted or spent.

gtm-engineer.task: Write a one-page launch board for the next 7 days: positioning statement, 5 launch steps with owners, and 3 outbound message drafts (drafts only).

seo-employee.task: Propose 10 target keywords (with search intent) and draft one 400-word article outline plus an FAQ block written so AI answer engines can quote it.

web-dev-employee.task: Produce a technical audit checklist for the client's website (speed, broken links, metadata, mobile, dependencies) with a priority for each item.

social-media-employee.task: Draft 5 social posts (2 LinkedIn, 2 Instagram, 1 X) in a warm, expert brand voice. Posts are drafts for human approval.

ad-manager-employee.task: Write a weekly ad performance read-out template and a change list of 5 concrete, low-risk optimisations to propose (no spend is made).

sales-employee.task: Define the ideal customer profile in 5 bullets and draft 3 short first-touch emails for different segments (drafts only, never sent).

customer-satisfaction-employee.task: Create a support triage taxonomy (6 categories), 3 reply templates, and a list of churn-risk signals to watch for.

chief-of-staff.task: Summarise in 5 lines what the agency should decide this week, based on the reports of the other employees if provided.
